FULL REDO. Prior AI tiles are slop: holes punched through the white windshield, 95 stuck on the toe instead of the sidewall, flat blue-dot eyes, missing bumper smile. Do NOT use any public/products/new/cars-mcqueen* file as a reference.

This is the official Disney Pixar Cars Lightning McQueen Classic Clog. Racing-red Croslite foam, matching red strap.

VAMP (top of the clog, not the sidewall): a windshield print wrapping the curve of the upper — two white almond/lobe shapes with light-blue irises and black pupils looking TOWARD THE TOE, grey windshield frame. Vent holes sit on RED foam AROUND the windshield; NEVER punch a hole through the white face.

FRONT BUMPER (toe tip): small printed smirk/smile with white teeth — not a ventilation slit standing in as a mouth.

SIDEWALL (strict side profile): large slanted yellow 95 with black outline, yellow-orange lightning/flame trail toward the heel, circular Rust-eze Medicated Bumper Ointment logo near the heel, stacked small sponsor rectangles (Piston Cup / Octane Gain / RPM / Clutch Aid) near the toe, black dual-exhaust graphic along the lower sidewall, red/yellow taillight at the rear, headlight graphic near the front corner. 95 lives on the SIDE, never on the vamp.

HEEL: raised red panel with yellow 'crocs' wordmark; strap forward (clog mode) with 'crocs' embossed on the circular pivot.

REJECT if: eyes are two solid blue dots on a flat white rectangle; a Crocs hole cuts the windshield; 95 is on the toe box; extra figurines/people/tags/green hanger; left-facing toe; checkerboard or white halo on the cutout.
